Apartment information: Total area: 96 m² Floor: 3 living New construction, 2018 With mortgage The apartment has: Living room and kitchen 2 bedrooms 1 bathroom 1 balcony Other settings: Fully furnished with contemporary conditions New and well-managed building Functional layout and natural lighting throughout the day Very favorable location, close to schools, markets and transport public For more information or to visit it up close, please contact us!
